The Router was lenient here, but given the visual evidence of a stem rising from the bottom, it is acceptable to mark as present with a note on ambiguity.

Regarding the lower stem, the severity of 2.0 is appropriate—it doesn't fully collapse, but it does fade unnaturally into the background. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortions, which supports the idea that the main subject is high quality, but it missed the subtle boundary issues noted by the Router. The Topology Auditor's high confidence mask confirms the main flower is a coherent entity, but the mask image shows some irregularity at the bottom edge, consistent with the stem fading issue.

These are minor structural/textural issues that do not detract significantly from the overall realism of the main subject but prevent a perfect score.
